description: This file defines columns for a model hub table component, including rendering logic, sorting, and filtering for various model attributes such as name, provider, mode, tokens, cost, capabilities, and public status. It exports a function to generate column definitions based on parameters.

methods.name: formatCapabilityName
methods.description: Formats a capability key string into a human-readable name.

methods.name: getModelCapabilities
methods.description: Extracts supported capabilities from a ModelHubData object.

methods.name: formatCost
methods.description: Formats a number as a dollar cost per million tokens.

methods.name: formatTokens
methods.description: Converts token counts into human-readable strings with suffixes.
